notes: Added API/UI, integration, and test coverage stories to complete Consent Workflow.

change_log.value: Consent Flow Integration with Tool Router
change_log.note: Ensure consent enforced across tool execution

stories.title: Consent API Endpoints
stories.description: Implement FastAPI endpoints to capture, update, and retrieve consent status. Endpoints must support Tier 1 and Tier 2 consent flows and return current consent state for downstream services.

stories.title: Consent Flow Integration with Tool Router
stories.description: Integrate consent checks into the tool_router to ensure that any tool execution involving storage or PII enforces the correct consent tier before proceeding.

stories.title: Frontend Consent Interaction Handling
stories.description: Enable frontend chat flow to trigger consent prompts and send user responses to backend APIs. Ensure proper handling of consent tier selection and retry logic for incomplete flows.

stories.title: Consent Workflow Test Suite
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering consent creation, upgrade, downgrade, revocation, API endpoints, and enforcement in tool routing. Validate de-identification behavior under Tier 1.
